Text.Text: The backroom bill is closed. Take your purse, and give that routine a better audience. You've finished my Tempest Bloom trials. I have no further work for you here.
This bill needs rank 50 in Twin Blade. Reach it, then come back. I'll save the grand introduction until your hands can keep up with it.

Someone's selling my paired-blade routine as backroom blood sport. Bring me their bout ledger so I can see every fight they've booked. Defeat six Tempest Bloom Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor. I'll give you the Smuggler's Moon Fight Club Backrooms Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Tempest Bloom.

Here's the Smuggler's Moon Fight Club Backrooms Key. Use '[Back Rooms]' in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Tempest Bloom Adepts, then return with the Tempest Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger.

The only act I ever announced twice in one breath. Both blades open outward like petals -- pretty, the crowd sighs -- then the whole shape collapses inward and it's a storm with edges. Done right, it's the finish nobody sees and everybody remembers. Done the way they teach it downstairs, it's butchery with choreography.

Promoters who got greedy and fighters who got tired of my rules. They sealed off the old backrooms -- the door behind the main pit, the one your key fits. Past it, the halls are theirs: pit after pit, no bell, no doctor, no me. Everything you need to hurt is inside.

Undercard material, but don't smile yet. Six of them, and they train on people who can't leave. Any one alone would make a decent show against you. They won't come alone -- that's not the kind of bill it is. Warm up before you go down. I mean that.
Defeat six Tempest Bloom Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor.
You've defeated six Tempest Bloom Adepts. Let me see the Tempest Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger.
The book is back in honest hands. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using the ring's shock regulator in their act. Take it out of the bill. Defeat five Tempest Bloom Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Ring Shock Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Defeat five Tempest Bloom Specialists to secure the Tempest Bloom Ring Shock Regulator, then return to me.

Faster than the adepts and twice as vain. Each one has polished a single petal of the bloom to a mirror shine -- one leads left, one only counters, one throws both blades wide and gambles you'll flinch. Alone, each is a solvable puzzle. In those pits they'll rotate on you like a rehearsed finale. Solve fast.

A ring shock regulator keeps an honest pit honest -- kills the current the instant a fighter goes down. They rewired theirs to do the opposite. Fighter drops, the floor bites them back up. That's how they've been selling half-dead men as comeback stories. Pull it off the wall and the pits go back to being merely lethal.

Because I sold spectacle and somebody else sold blood, and blood outdraws me ten to one on this moon. Promoters moved downstairs, my old sound rig went with them, and half a season later there's a second club under my club. I book the crowd. They book the graves. That ends bout by bout, starting with yours.

Defeat five Tempest Bloom Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Ring Shock Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor.
You've defeated five Tempest Bloom Specialists. Let me see the Tempest Bloom Ring Shock Regulator.
One less rigged test to worry about. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the backroom show. Recover his pit sigil and end that protection. Defeat the Tempest Bloom Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Tempest Bloom Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Tempest Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil.

Fourteen seasons, no losses, and I called every one of his fights from the good microphone. He does the bloom the way a glacier does patience -- slow openings you don't notice until both his edges are already through your guard. When the backroom bill started, they gave him the deep door because nobody would buy a ticket to him anymore. Fear is bad box office.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Tempest Bloom Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Every backroom fighter carries a pit sigil -- their license, their name, their tally. His cracked the night his trainer died on his blades, and he kept wearing it broken, which tells you what kind of sermon he is. On my desk, that sigil closes fourteen seasons of business the bill has been trading on. It's the difference between hurting them and unlicensing them.

Defeat the Tempest Bloom Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Tempest Bloom Warden. Let me see the Tempest Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil.
The warden's protection is broken. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four running the circuit still hold its payout chit. Recover it so we can close their bill. Defeat four members of the Tempest Bloom Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Defeat four members of the Tempest Bloom Inner Circle to secure the Tempest Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit, then return to me.

My best students, once. I taught them the bloom for the crowd; the promoter re-taught it for the payout. One announces her strikes the way I announce fighters -- listen and you'll live. One only fights out of corners. The twins finish each other's combinations, so never stand between them. I'd say take them one at a time, but they won't offer, and past the warden's gate nobody comes running when you shout. Keep your company close.

The promoter signs payout chits by hand because he doesn't trust the banks. The circle's chit records the fights and deaths he paid for. It's evidence we need to close their bill, not another entrance key.

Not yet. Ask me when the circle's done and I'll tell you about the only act I ever refused to announce twice. Short version to hold you over: the master's final bloom emptied this house once -- fighters, bookies, the boy who sold caf at the door. I sold the tickets to it. That's my share of the bill, and it's why I'm still at this desk instead of retired somewhere with weather.

Defeat four members of the Tempest Bloom Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Tempest Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor.
You've defeated four members of the Tempest Bloom Inner Circle. Let me see the Tempest Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit.
That closes the crew's account. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the last act keeping the circuit alive. Defeat him in the Private Pit and give this show an ending. Defeat the Tempest Bloom Master in Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Tempest Bloom Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Don't let him set the rhythm of the whole fight. Bring companions, share the pressure, and help whoever his paired blades turn on. He knows the form well; your advantage is a plan he has to answer instead of one he can dictate.

Then it's yours. That's not a figure of speech -- the form passes to whoever finishes its keeper, and that custom is older than my club and older than this moon's bad plumbing. You'd walk up those stairs carrying the real Tempest Bloom, the one I used to sell as a miracle at two credits a seat. Be gentler with it than he was. Or at least pick better audiences.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Tempest Bloom Master fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Tempest Bloom Master in Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, The Tilted Visor; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Tempest Bloom Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The backroom bill is closed. Take your purse, and give that routine a better audience. You've earned the right to train Tempest Bloom. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the job.
I'll defeat six Tempest Bloom Adepts.
What exactly is the Tempest Bloom?
Who's running this second bill?
What are these adepts like?
Not tonight, Brask.
Here's the Tempest Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger.
Run the card by me again.
I'll defeat five Tempest Bloom Specialists.
How do their specialists fight?
What does this regulator do?
How did the bill get this deep under your club?
I'll pass for now.
Here's the Tempest Bloom Ring Shock Regulator.
Back to the warden.
I'll defeat the Tempest Bloom Warden.
Who was the warden before the door?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What does the sigil matter?
Not until I've picked my seconds.
Here's the Tempest Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil.
Back to the circle.
I'll defeat four members of the Tempest Bloom Inner Circle.
Who are the four?
What's on this payout chit?
And after them -- the master?
Give me a day first.
Here's the Tempest Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit.
Tell me about the main event again.
I'll face the Tempest Bloom Master and report back.
Can he be beaten at his own form?
What happens to the bloom when he's gone?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Not tonight. This one deserves my best.
The Tempest Bloom Master is defeated. Here's my report.
